title: Nazi occult documents found in a cave

tellings.quote: In 1945, near the end of the war, American forces uncovered a hidden stash of Nazi documents in a cave in southern Germany. Among them were records revealing real state-sponsored occult projects.

plain: In 1945, near the end of the war, American forces found a hidden stash of Nazi documents in a cave in southern Germany, among them records of real state-sponsored occult projects. Michels tells it himself without naming a source, as a way into how occult ideas may have travelled into postwar science.
